claims.text: Reviewers frequently report visible skin improvements, such as clearer, more hydrated, or more youthful-looking skin, after a few weeks of use.
Many users praise the oil for absorbing quickly and not being greasy, making it suitable for nighttime use without waking up oily.
Several reviewers note the oil has a distinct scent (nutty or rose-like) that some dislike initially but find dissipates quickly.
Some reviewers mention the oil helps reduce the appearance of acne scars and discoloration.
A few reviewers report issues with the dropper or packaging.
